'''Ladra''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] servant of the [[King/Legends|monarchy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drogheda/Legends|Drogheda]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. An aide to [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Sarna (Queen)|Sarna]], she showed [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] to his quarters when the man came to stay in the [[Drogheda Citadel]] during the [[Drogheda Civil War]].<ref name="marvel83" />
